query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as dias_lancados,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat1,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat2,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat3,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat4,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat5,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat6,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat7,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat8,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat9,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
      CAST(f.cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
      CAST(f.cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(f.cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as TOTAL_GERAL
FROM faturamentos f
WHERE f.empresaSlug = 'MORUMBI'
  AND f.data LIKE '2026-03-%';
